title: Public enums missing #[non_exhaustive]
description:
**File:** rust/lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs

**Issue:** Several public enums are missing `#[non_exhaustive]`:

- `GatewayRole` (line 67)
- `MultiInstanceError` (line 132)
- `VersionChangeOutcome` (line 780)

**Impact:** Adding new variants in future versions would be a semver-breaking change. Callers with exhaustive matches will fail to compile.

**Fix:** Add `#[non_exhaustive]` to each:
```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
#[non_exhaustive]
pub enum GatewayRole {
    Primary,
    Secondary,
    Standalone,
}
```
